title: Model Warlock Pact Boons and Eldritch Invocations
description:
Problem:
Warlock has two high-impact option families that are currently under-modeled:
- feature:warlock:pact-boon contains Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, and Pact of the Tome as prose.
- feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations contains 32 invocation options as prose and one generic choice.

Implement:
- Emit structured Pact Boon options with stable ids and links from the Pact Boon feature.
- Emit structured Eldritch Invocation options with stable ids.
- Capture invocation prerequisites from the SRD where present.
- Link the Eldritch Invocations feature choice to the invocation option catalog.
- Preserve each option's SRD prose and source location.
- Keep option effects prose-backed unless a deterministic effect projection is already obvious and tested.

Acceptance criteria:
- A deterministic character creation flow can list Pact Boon options.
- A deterministic character creation flow can list Eldritch Invocations and inspect prerequisites.
- Selected Pact Boon and selected invocations can be stored by stable id.
- The choice-bearing prose audit no longer flags these Warlock records.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented Warlock Pact Boon/Eldritch Invocation option catalogs and contingent spell filters
